name: Downside Risk Parity (core 8)
description: Equalizes each asset's contribution to portfolio downside risk using the semicovariance matrix (below-target return co-movements) in place of full covariance (Roncalli 2013 risk-budgeting with alternative risk measures). Distinct from full-vol RiskParity (equalizes total-vol contributions) and MinimumSemivariance (minimizes downside variance). Long-only, weights sum to 1.
